steps.title: Crude leaf extraction
steps.instruction: Extract DNA from leaf petioles using bead beating and centrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Place <50 mg leaf petioles, a metal bead, and 1 mL extraction buffer into a tube.
Shake at 2,500 rpm for 60 s using a Multi‑beads shocker.
Centrifuge at 9,000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C.
Transfer the supernatant to a new tube; optionally store at –20 °C or keep on ice.

steps.title: Isopropanol precipitation
steps.instruction: Precipitate nucleic acids from the crude extract with cold isopropanol.

substeps.instruction: Add an equal volume of cold isopropanol to the crude extract and mix thoroughly.
Centrifuge at 20,000 × g for 5 min at 4 °C.
Discard the supernatant and air‑dry the pellet.
Resuspend the pellet in one‑fifth the original volume of TE buffer; optionally store at –20 °C or keep on ice.

steps.title: Data analysis
steps.instruction: Process qPCR results to determine positive samples.

substeps.instruction: Classify samples as positive for Phytoplasma (PP) or Xylella (XL) when Ct < 45, and internal control (IC) when Ct < 40.
Consult the referenced PDF protocol (Japanese/English) in the abstract for detailed interpretation.
